questions.prompt: Which of the following is a disadvantage of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)?
options: Symmetry in how inputs are processed.
Difficulty accessing information from many steps back.
Weights are not reused across timesteps.
accepted: Difficulty accessing information from many steps back.

questions.prompt: Why are RNNs preferred over fixed-window neural models?
options: They have a smaller parameter size.
They can process sequences of arbitrary length.
They eliminate the need for embedding layers.
accepted: They can process sequences of arbitrary length.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the cell state in an LSTM?
options: Control the gradient flow across timesteps.
